feedback: can you add more visual flair to the avatars and floats, like the avatar should be more similar to FrostBite guy, etc etc, like more visually thematic to the actually frostbite game, retain the 2.5D aesthetic

selection.reason: Updating visual flair for the avatar and floats can be accomplished by modifying the rendering logic to draw more detailed, thematic 2.5D shapes without altering physics or game state.

patch.notes: Added visual flair thematic to the original Frostbite: The player avatar is now drawn as an Eskimo in a purple parka (Frostbite Bailey-like). Floats are drawn as icy white chunks with distinct visual highlights. The Igloo builds up visually block-by-block and flashes brightly when completed. Banks changed from dull grey to snowy white, and water darkened to contrast the ice and player.
